Balneotherapy Heritage: From Ancient Anchialos to Pomorie
Sotir Kichukov
4 min read
From Ancient Anchialos to Modern Pomorie
Located on a narrow Black Sea peninsula 20 km from Burgas, the coastal town of Pomorie carries millennia of maritime history. In the 6th century BC, Greek settlers named the settlement Anchialos — literally meaning 'by the salt sea'. During Roman times and up through the 20th century, travelers visited the lagoon for traditional sea-salt harvesting and mineral bath rituals.
What Balneology Means in Everyday Self-Care
The word balneotherapy comes from the Greek 'balneo' (bath) and describes the age-old cultural tradition of soaking in mineral-rich coastal springs, lagoons, and salt waters to relax, refresh the body, and pamper the skin.
A Tradition Trusted by Bulgarian Combat & Olympic Athletes
Pomorie's coastal resorts, including Grand Hotel Pomorie, have long hosted Bulgarian national wrestling teams, MMA and kickboxing champions, and Olympic competitors for post-camp rest and mineral bath routines. Among those athletes is Sotir Kichukov, ONE Championship veteran and founder of CPT MMA in Melbourne, who now brings authentic Pomorie Lake Dual Magnesium cosmetics directly to Australian athletes and wellness studios.

body_text:
What Is Black Sea Lye? Inside Pomorie's Solar Mineral Harvest
Sotir Kichukov
4 min read
Along Bulgaria's southern Black Sea coast at Lake Pomorie and Lake Atanasovsko, sea-salt harvesting creates two natural products side by side: crystalline white sea salt at the base of the pan and a dense, amber mineral liquid above it known as Black Sea lye (luga).
How Solar Concentration Works
Hyper-saline lagoon water is channeled into shallow coastal basins during summer. As the sun evaporates fresh water, sodium chloride precipitates down onto the pan floor. The remaining uncrystallized liquid concentrates bioavailable Magnesium Chloride (MgCl2), Magnesium Sulfate (MgSO4), trace bromide, and coastal minerals.
Why Stabilization Within 24 Hours Matters
Raw lye directly from a salt pan changes character rapidly when exposed to heat and air. To craft a stable, cosmetic-grade formula suitable for year-round bathroom storage, Azimut 6000 Ltd filters and stabilizes the brine under controlled ISO 22716 GMP conditions — locking in purity while keeping heavy metals below detectable limits (0.00 ppm).
Everyday Cosmetic Uses
Stabilized Black Sea lye forms the heart of ANCHIALO Dual Magnesium Gels and Pure Topical Brine Oil — crafted to nourish skin hydration, support post-activity massage comfort, and turn a home shower or foot soak into a coastal spa ritual.
